review_candidates.description: At Landis+Gyr, we're helping shape the future of energy—making it more intelligent, resilient, and sustainable. As a global energy technology leader, we're accelerating the energy evolution through purposeful innovation and trusted partnerships. Trusted by more than 2,000 utilities worldwide, our intelligent solutions connect devices, data, and decisions across the grid, helping customers modernize infrastructure, optimize operations, and deliver energy that is more reliable, resilient, accessible, safe, and sustainable. Behind every solution is a team of approximately 3,300 employees across more than 40 countries who are passionate about solving complex challenges, driving innovation, and making a meaningful impact for our utility customers and the communities they serve. Join Team Green and help shape the future of intelligent energy. Technical Implementation Manager The Technical Implementation Manager (TIM) owns the technical delivery of Landis+Gyr's AMI products and solutions for new customer deployments and upgrades. The role covers both containerized deployments on Kubernetes (GKE and RKE), delivered using CI/CD pipelines and automation, and multi-tier deployments of the Head-End System (HES) across Windows and Linux servers. Across both, the TIM takes the Landis+Gyr solution from environment readiness through to production, covering the full stack from head-end software to field network endpoints. Working closely with Program Managers, infrastructure teams, customer IT and operations teams, and Landis+Gyr engineering and product groups, the TIM is accountable for a successful go-live. This includes resolving technical issues that arise during deployment and the hypercare period, and transitioning the solution smoothly to the support organization. The role calls for deep hands-on DevOps expertise and a strong working knowledge of GCP, combined with the planning and customer-facing skills needed to deliver complex deployments on schedule. Key Responsibilities Own the end-to-end technical deployment of Landis+Gyr AMI solutions for new customers and upgrades, from environment readiness through go-live, planning activities with Program Managers and managing dependencies and risks. Validate that provisioned GCP and RKE environments meet deployment prerequisites, working with the infrastructure teams responsible for provisioning them. Deploy, configure and upgrade containerized applications on Kubernetes (GKE and RKE) using Docker and Helm charts. Install, configure and upgrade the Head-End System (HES) across its multi-tier architecture (network, metrology, web, application and adapter tiers) on Windows and Linux servers, including IIS and .NET-based components. Use and maintain CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins or similar) and scripting (PowerShell, Bash) to automate deployment, upgrade and rollback, and build reusable deployment templates across customers. Set up monitoring, logging and alerting so deployed applications are production-ready at go-live. Deliver integrations between the Landis+Gyr head-end and customer enterprise systems (e.g., MDM, CIS). Lead System Acceptance Testing (SAT) for new deployments and upgrades, driving defects to resolution. Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues during deployment and hypercare through root cause analysis, engaging engineering, product, infrastructure and support teams as needed. Manage the formal handover to support teams, including operational documentation, runbooks and knowledge transfer. Follow formal change control processes and keep ServiceNow records complete for deployment-phase changes and issues. Act as the customer's technical point of contact, leading technical workshops and liaising across Landis+Gyr business units throughout the deployment. Key Competencies Automation-first mindset, making every deployment repeatable, version-controlled and scripted Proven ownership of complex deployments end to end, from planning through go-live Strong planning and prioritization skills across parallel workstreams Methodical analytical and troubleshooting skills, with sound technical judgment Clear, confident communicator with customer technical teams, both written and verbal Self-starter who works independently, collaborates across teams and performs under time pressure Willingness to travel to customer sites (~50%) Technical Skills Required: Kubernetes: deploying and managing production workloads on GKE and RKE (Rancher Kubernetes Engine) Containers and packaging: Docker, Helm charts CI/CD: working with and maintaining pipelines in Jenkins or similar tools Google Cloud Platform (GCP): strong working knowledge of core services, as a user of GCP-hosted environments Infrastructure as code: working knowledge of Terraform Scripting and automation: PowerShell, Bash Version control: Git Operating systems: Linux/Unix and Microsoft Windows Server, for application deployment Databases: Oracle, MS SQL, PostgreSQL Networking: IP suite and wireless/RF/broadband communication technologies IIS and .NET Framework Preferred: Monitoring and observability tools (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, ELK) Hardware Security Modules (HSM) and load balancers Two-way AMI technology, from head-end software to field endpoints Qualifications – Education And Experience B.E./B.Tech in Electronics & Communication, Computer Science or IT 10+ years of industry experience, including at least 6 years in DevOps, cloud-based or technical deployment roles Experience deploying multi-tier enterprise applications on Windows and Linux server environments Experience delivering solutions that combine software and hardware Customer-facing experience, including independent travel to customer sites Energy utility or AMI operations experience is a plus We value and encourage diversity in our team. This position is open to all qualified candidates regardless of gender, race, age, disability, sexual orientation, or background. We're committed to shaping a better future for everyone. Join Team Green and be part of what's next in energy. #TeamGreen

review_candidates.title: Senior Network Production Engineer, Operations
review_candidates.description: Crusoe is on a mission to accelerate the abundance of energy and intelligence . As the only vertically integrated AI infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world's most ambitious AI workloads. When you join Crusoe, you join a team that is building the future, faster. We're in the midst of the greatest industrial revolution of our time. The demand for AI compute is boundless, and power is a bottleneck. We're solving that — with an energy-first approach that makes AI infrastructure better for the world and faster for the people innovating with AI. We're looking for problem-solving, opportunity-finding teammates with a sense of urgency, who believe in the scale of our ambition and thrive on a path not fully paved — people who want to grow their careers alongside a team of experts across energy, manufacturing, data center construction, and cloud services. If you want to do the most meaningful work of your career, help our customers and partners advance their AI strategies, and be part of a high-performing team that believes in each other, come build with us at Crusoe. About This Role: Crusoe Cloud is seeking a Senior Network Production Operations Engineer to support production reliability across our global network infrastructure, including edge, backbone, data center fabric, and GPU cluster interconnects. This is a hands-on production role focused on incident response, root cause analysis, and automation-driven operational execution that keeps our hyperscale AI infrastructure running at scale. Your work will directly affect the availability of AI workloads running across thousands of GPUs worldwide. The ideal candidate is an experienced network engineer with solid operational experience in large-scale environments who thrives in high-pressure situations and takes pride in keeping systems healthy. You'll build automation to reduce operational toil, execute on established SLIs and SLOs, contribute to observability tooling, and serve as a responder during high-severity network events. What You'll Be Working On: Production Reliability: Support uptime across Crusoe's global edge, backbone, data center, and GPU cluster network, directly supporting AI workloads at scale. Operational Automation: Write and maintain Python-based tooling to reduce toil, automate common remediation workflows, and speed up mean time to resolution across the operations org. Incident Response: Participate in high-severity network events — detection, triage, mitigation — and contribute to stakeholder communication and postmortem documentation. Root Cause Analysis: Perform RCAs using existing and newly built tooling, and help drive remediation items to closure. Observability: Build automation on top of Crusoe's monitoring stack (streaming telemetry, SNMP, NetFlow, Kentik, Grafana, Prometheus, ThousandEyes) to reduce manual triage and surface actionable signal faster. Operational Standards: Maintain and improve runbooks, escalation playbooks, and SOPs, flagging opportunities for scripting or automation. SLI/SLO Execution: Help build and maintain the automated dashboards and alerting that back reliability metrics, in partnership with Architecture and SRE teams. Collaboration: Work closely with Architecture and SRE teams to execute on operational excellence initiatives and improve day-to-day practices. What You'll Bring to the Team: 5+ years of production network engineering experience with a focus on operations, incident response, and reliability in large-scale or internet-scale environments. Strong Python and scripting proficiency: comfortable writing diagnostic tooling and automation scripts, and extending existing automation pipelines. Hands-on experience with observability and monitoring tools including streaming telemetry, SNMP, NetFlow/sFlow, Grafana, Prometheus, and ThousandEyes, and the ability to script against their APIs. Experience operating RDMA/RoCE lossless fabrics for GPU or HPC workloads, including familiarity with PFC, ECN, and DCQCN tuning. Solid hands-on knowledge of BGP, EVPN-VXLAN, IS-IS, OSPF, MPLS, QoS, and TCP/IP in production data center environments. Proficiency with Arista (EOS) and Juniper (Junos) platforms in leaf-spine CLOS architectures across multi-vendor environments. Comfort operating large device fleets across multi-region environments with on-call responsibility. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Bonus Points: Experience with NVIDIA/Mellanox networking platforms in GPU cluster environments. Familiarity with Kentik or Arbor for traffic analysis and DDoS visibility. Exposure to contributing to SLIs and SLOs alongside SRE or product teams. Exposure to operating 10K+ device fleets across hyperscale or cloud environments. Benefits: Competitive compensation Restricted Stock Units Paid time off & paid holidays Comprehensive health, dental & vision insurance Employer contributions to HSA account Paid parental leave Paid life insurance, short-term and long-term disability Professional development & tuition reimbursement Mental health & wellness support Commuter benefits (parking & transit) Cell phone stipend 401(k) Retirement plan with company match up to 4% of salary Volunteer time off Compensation Range: Compensation will be paid in the range of $165,000 - $200,000 plus Bonus. Restricted Stock Units are included in all offers. Compensation to be determined by the applicant’s education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data. review_candidates.description: About Us PXC is a wholesale platform business that shares over 20 years of experience across the channel, thanks to our roots in TalkTalk Wholesale Services and Virtual1. Now, we’re determined to challenge the status quo – for our partners, and our people. Job Description This role is based in North Macedonia. PXC (part of the TalkTalk Group) is the UK’s leading value for money connectivity provider. We believe that simple, affordable, reliable, and fair connectivity should be available to everyone, and we reward our team for being part of that mission of change. About the team Part of PXC’s Technical Operations function, the Technology and Security Operations Centre (TSOC) is the heartbeat of our organisation. We’re a collaborative, high‑performing team that pairs deep operational expertise with innovative thinking to keep our customers ’ services — and our network and applications — running securely and reliably.   Our team is responsible for identifying and managing network and security issues that impact both customers and colleagues, while also supporting our partners’ voice and data services.   Using modern monitoring and detection platforms, automation, and data‑driven insights, we proactively detect, investigate, and resolve network and security issues affecting both customers and colleagues. minimising impact by adhering to KPIs and industry best practices. Collaboration is key—we work closely with internal teams and external partners to keep services running smoothly and securely. Requirements ​ About Your Role Reporting to our Network Assurance Operations Manager, you’ll be part of a skilled team of network and security engineers, working closely with another Network Assurance Operations Specialist Team as well as four other rotating shift teams to deliver a seamless technical Assurance operation. Your primary responsibility will be to identify, manage, and resolve assurance faults impacting our partners’ voice and data services. This role follows a dayshift working hours, working days, with the addition of a late shift (12:00 – 20:00) on rotation basis. ​Key responsibilities will include but not be limited to: • Troubleshooting and resolving escalated tickets and requests from our 1st Line triage Team • Identify and respond to a variety of issues and assignments, providing technical analysis and then implementing resolution steps to restore and improve services for our customers and colleagues. You will lead as well as support issues with other SME’s or IM teams. • Responsible for detailed recording of faults and faults including but not limited to a technical and non-technical explanation of operational impact, customer impact, progress, actions, and resolution. Ensuring stakeholders are kept up to date on progression and next steps, whilst driving suppliers and internal resolver groups towards restoring services within agreed SLA's. • Identify and record service requests following root cause analysis and the restoration of faults, champion a culture of operational excellence through continual service improvements, particularly those that will lead to improved KPI’s, ensuring they are progressed appropriately. • Support the development and maintenance of playbooks and knowledge transfer, where required. • Accountable for attending team, departmental and company updates and ensuring you are engaged in all necessary comms channels to receive necessary company updates. • Demonstrate an appreciation of the wider business context and values. At times contributing to daily fault calls producing and/or delivering updates on daily and weekly metrics and reports. • Responsible for ensuring the security and integrity of network & IT systems by adherence to the company's Information Security policies and procedures. • Authorised to access and make changes on live managed equipment, to ensure appropriate controls are in place to protect PXC and its customers. Authorised to approve engineer access to PXC and third-party data centres. Success Criteria Essential : • Demonstrable Technical knowledge Infra/Network/Security experience • Understanding of Network and optional Security Principles and practical application of these in relation to Fault Triage and Response • Self-motivated; good time-keeping and customer-value work ethic. • Strong analytical skills: gathers evidence, investigates solutions, considers implications for the business, goal-orientated  • Demonstrate ability to problem solve, prioritising routine and non-routine tasks and work accurately and quickly in a high-pressure incident situation • Ability to communicate and advise on security and network topics to key stakeholders in an understandable form Desirable : • Relevant Security or Network qualification or degree • Experience working in a Network/Security Support function • Practical experience with the latest technologies and vulnerabilities, exploits and malware • JNCIA/CCNP certified Benefits Wellbeing, because we care : FitKit wellness programme, day off for your birthday, paid volunteering time for causes you care about plus other benefits that are a part of our Health & Wellbeing programme. Flexibility : a flexible working policy, including hybrid working. Learning : LinkedIn Learning to build your skills on demand. Rewarded : an annual bonus based on company performance, plus a reward and recognition programme.
